description: This file is a test class for the VertxBasedHealthCheckServer in the Eclipse Hono project, specifically testing various configurations and endpoints of the health check server behavior using JUnit 5 and Vert.x testing extensions.

classes.name: VertxBasedHealthCheckServerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of VertxBasedHealthCheckServer configurations and endpoints.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup after each test, stopping the server if it was started.

methods.name: testHealthCheckServerWithNoBindAddressFailsToStart
methods.description: Verifies server behavior when no bind address is provided, expecting startup failure.

methods.name: testHealthCheckServerWithInsecureEndpoint
methods.description: Verifies that the health check server responds correctly at an insecure endpoint.

methods.name: testHealthCheckServerWithSecureEndpoint
methods.description: Verifies that the health check server responds correctly at a secure endpoint.

methods.name: testHealthCheckServerWithSecureAndInsecureEndpoint
methods.description: Verifies that the server can run both secure and insecure endpoints simultaneously.

methods.name: registerHealthChecks
methods.description: Registers readiness and liveness health checks with the server, flags checkpoints.

methods.name: checkHealth
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to a health check endpoint and verifies the response.

methods.name: getWebClient
methods.description: Creates a WebClient configured for secure or insecure communication with the server.
